## EMPIRICAL THERAPY FOR NECROTIZING INFECTIONS
## Preferred treatment:
## Inpatient/Outpatient

Piperacillin-tazobactam 3.375 gm IV q6h ($$) [R] <AND> clindamycin 900 mg
IV q8h ($$) [H,O] <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h ($) [R]
< OR >
Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h ($) [M] <AND> clindamycin 900 mg IV q8h ($$)
($$) [H,O] <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h ($) [R]
Meropenem 1gm IV q8h ($$) <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h ($) [R]
## Alternatives for penicillin allergy
Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV q12h ($) [R,DI] <AND> clindamycin 900 mg IV
q8h ($$) [H,O] <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h ($) [R]
< OR >
Gentamicin 5 mg/kg IV q24h ($) [R,O] <AND> clindamycin 900 mg IV q8h
($$) [H,O] <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h ($) [R]
## ER

Piperacillin-tazobactam 3.375 gm IV STAT ($$) [R] <AND> clindamycin 900 mg
IV STAT ($$) [H,O] <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV STAT ($) [R]
< OR >
Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV STAT ($) [M] <AND> clindamycin 900 mg IV STAT ($$)
($$) [H,O] <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV STAT ($) [R]
< OR >
Meropenem 1gm IV STAT ($$) <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV STAT ($) [R]
## Alternatives for penicillin allergy
Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV STAT ($) [R,DI] <AND> clindamycin 900 mg IV
STAT ($$) [H,O] <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV STAT ($) [R]
< OR >
Gentamicin 5 mg/kg IV STAT ($) [R,O] <AND> clindamycin 900 mg IV STAT
($$) [H,O] <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV STAT ($) [R]
